title: The Advanced Companion to Endless Force
summary: A companion for those past the courses that teaches force to build on itself until a single exchange swells into a surge no guard can hold.

title: A Master's Treatise on Unbroken Defense
summary: A treatise on guards and mending that renew themselves as fast as they are spent so that the user can stand through a long siege of blows.

title: A Twin-Court Canon of the Doubling Line
summary: A canon of dual-track work where each motion is paired with its echo and the pair is doubled again without end.

title: The Hawk's Unending Flight Manual
summary: A manual in the way of the hawk whose dive and climb are linked in a flight that never has to land.

title: The Oath of the Held Bearing
summary: A book of vows that keep their bearing without end so that a sworn effort is never spent and a held line is never lost.

title: A Windward Treatise on the Unceasing Gale
summary: A treatise on a gale that does not drop when the wind-sworn keep it fed and that grows stronger the longer it blows.
